verdict.rationale: xAI publishes dated migration guides for model retirements (e.g., the May 15, 2026 retirement notice) that give advance notice, specify redirect behavior so old slugs keep resolving to `grok-4.3` without code changes, and note pricing impact, plus a documented alias/versioning scheme (`-latest` vs pinned versions) that supports planned migration paths. Missing for 10: an explicit general policy statement committing to a minimum notice period across all models, and independent/community corroboration that retirements consistently follow this process.
